item.title: UFW and Docker
item.description: For the generic UFW setup, see Linux Systems Setup. This is the dockerhost firewall: a host layer (ufw) and a Docker layer on top of it (ufw-docker). Its rules rely on Docker allocating networks inside 172.16.0.0/12 only, which its pinned address pools guarantee (the WireGuard network, 10.100.0.0/24, is set by hand).
